# sqwod.life

> Bilingual (English / German) intelligence-and-media brand for the business of fitness and wellness. Market data, honest gear reviews with a published scoring method, evidence-graded coaching playbooks, and a weekday briefing for coaches, trainers, studio founders and operators. Published by Sqwod (Berlin), the company behind Sqwod Pod private training rooms.

Every page exists in both languages: /en/... and /de/... are 1:1 counterparts. Figures carry an as-of date and a named source; reviews show a Sqwod Score (0-100) built from a public criteria scorecard plus aggregated crowd ratings. Affiliate links are labelled on-page.

## Intelligence (data reports)
- [State of Wearables 2026](https://sqwod.life/en/intelligence/wearables-84bn-market/): open-access flagship report on the wearables market, with downloadable figures (CSV/JSON) and a citation block
- [Member retention benchmark](https://sqwod.life/en/intelligence/member-retention-benchmark/): churn and retention figures for gyms and studios
- [Ghosted members](https://sqwod.life/en/intelligence/ghosted-members/): lapsed-member data and the re-activation case
- [Pilates reformer boom](https://sqwod.life/en/intelligence/pilates-reformer-boom/): growth data behind the reformer-studio wave
- [All reports](https://sqwod.life/en/intelligence/): index; most reports are free with an email unlock

- [Best studio tools](https://sqwod.life/en/best/studio-tools/): ranked guide
- [Best apparel](https://sqwod.life/en/best/apparel/): ranked guide
- [Affiliate disclosure](https://sqwod.life/en/verified/disclosure/): how links are labelled and paid

## Evidence (research-graded coaching playbooks)
- [Evidence lane](https://sqwod.life/en/evidence/): playbooks that grade the research (PMIDs/DOIs cited inline)
- [Evidence methodology](https://sqwod.life/en/evidence/methodology/): how studies are graded

## Articles by lane
- [Signal](https://sqwod.life/en/articles/signal/): industry trends and market moves
- [Build](https://sqwod.life/en/articles/build/): growth and operations playbooks for coaches and studios
- [Move](https://sqwod.life/en/articles/move/): training method and programming
